normalization: Per-character casefold then NFKD with combining marks removed and a map back to exact original offsets; retrieval only.
source_cartilage_association: A cue is associated with the cartilage family when any recognized cartilage anchor appears within 160 original characters either side. This is not compartment or injury attribution.
source_numeric_extent_limit: An extent cue anywhere in the report may refer to a cyst, meniscus, other compartment or prior finding. Every positive OA cell remains selected regardless of cue presence.
numeric_grade_limit: Grades in nearby ligaments/menisci may be retrieved. Recognized framework names may refer to a different sentence/compartment. Grade-only is an explicit lexical proxy, not a semantic conclusion that the full source offers no other support.
mixed_severity_limit: Low/high terms and grade values may concern different locations, lesions, history or negations. Co-occurrence only nominates source review; no contradiction is declared.
named_framework_limit: Recognizing ICRS/Outerbridge/Noyes does not establish any clinical grade mapping or prove depth/extent. Other named frameworks can be missed.
coverage_and_recall: All 13221 cells and all effective positives are accounted for. Nonpositive selection remains lexical and can miss rare languages, transliteration, Greek-letter numerals, abbreviations, punctuation, misspellings and paraphrases. Absence of a cue is not absence of evidence.
trigger_implementation: Exact deterministic choose_triggers function in bound build_inventory.py. No candidate state is assigned or changed; existing states are inspection metadata only.
neutral_order: Original source batch/index order, at most ten complete reports per packet, no priority or label clues inside packets.
synthetic_retrieval_checks: Unicode source offsets, numeric grade retrieval, framework retrieval, full-thickness cue, mixed lexical severity, dimension cue, disclosed Greek-letter gap, negated-cue inclusion without error inference, and unconditional positive-cell selection.
